label: Rétro

provenance.incarnation: Major Zero original MGS3 PS2,1964; gray swept-back hair/headset, dark leather fur collar flight jacket/shirt/turquoise tie, camo trousers, tall combat boots. M1911A1/grenade are actual CQC gameplay kit adaptation, not claimed canonical personal ownership.

sources.scope: Original/classic design reference. Rétro costume style and CQC gameplay motions are newly authored adaptations; no frame-perfect retail animation claim.
